ns2:section.sectionText: Pre-requisites: MCB 150 or PSYC 210 plus 413, 414, or 451, or approval by instructor. In this seminar course we will issues in neurometabolism, highlighting research focused on glycolytic and oxidative metabolism in brain and how metabolic changes influence learning and memory. Special attention will be given to metabolic regulation of synaptic plasticity, neural protection against disease, and aging. Current and historic findings will be discussed through formal presentations, research talks, and journal-club like discussions.
